## Historical Scene execution audit

**Scope and provenance.** Citations below give source ID, exact lines and a path relative to the expanded-file root `P=/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/`. All cited files are also members of archive `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r2--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, under `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/` plus the same relative path. No reference or render images were supplied for visual inspection.

### Metalworking workshop: `commons_155212263`

- **Code intent.** Selected step 2 uses SceneAct boxes, rods and swept tubes for floorboards, windows, a long bench and drawers, an anvil, three flywheel machines, vises and tools. The cream bucket is an assembly of 40 sloping rods, a base and two swept rims—not a continuous modeled shell. Coordinates specify placement, not verified contact or fidelity. [X0935, `test/commons_155212263/steps/002/build.py`, lines 13–53, 62–104, 106–163, 212–229]
- **Materials and view.** After realization, noise drives a color ramp and bump on Principled materials; near-neutral dark colors receive metallic treatment, and blue-rich colors emission. The script specifies a 44 mm view, three area lights, node-based ambient world, Cycles, 48 samples, 512×384 and AgX exposure −0.25. These are script settings, not all confirmed effective render settings. [X0935, same file, lines 248–302]
- **Execution.** Step 1 failed before rendering because the world was `None`; step 2 creates a world if absent and successfully saved a PNG and blend. Its actual log reports **16/16 samples**, not the scripted 48. Step 3 timed out at approximately 522.7 seconds, with no image. [X0934, `test/commons_155212263/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0935, lines 288–297; X0936, `test/commons_155212263/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0938, `test/commons_155212263/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]
- **Selection and checks.** `selected.json` names step 2 although the record’s `selected` field is null. The record marks valid and structural/material/composite checks passed for `cream_bucket_rim`, but explicitly limits them to edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Overall similarity is 0.3494. A later blue-workbench text edit reports exit code 0, not proof that the requested changes or preservation were visually correct. [X0931, `test/commons_155212263/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0930, `test/commons_155212263/record.json`, lines 16–34, 56–57; X0940, `test/commons_155212263/text_edit/status.json`, lines 2–5]

### Electronics workbench: `commons_16007442`

The selected step 3 uses grouped box assets for the monitor, meters, keyboard and calculator; small controls are instead batched by material into meshes, with separate polyline curves for cables and font objects for labels. Thus a calculator asset exists, but its batched keys are not necessarily children of that asset. The code uses flat-colored Principled finishes at roughness 0.68 for its detail materials, rather than image textures. [X0949, `test/commons_16007442/steps/003/build.py`, lines 12–29, 47–81, 110–173, 204–208, 402–425]

The scripted view is 43 mm with two area emitters, ambient world, Cycles 24 samples, denoising and 512×388; the task metadata also specifies 512×388. Step 1 timed out at 600 seconds; step 2 failed on a missing world; step 3 created one and logged a finished **16-sample** render and saved PNG/blend. [X0949, lines 427–447; X0951, `test/commons_16007442/task.json`, lines 2–5; X0946, `test/commons_16007442/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0948, `test/commons_16007442/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0950, `test/commons_16007442/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]

Step 3 is recorded as selected; the record reports valid, functional passes for `Calculator`, and overall 0.4459, with semantic completeness and collision truth unmeasured. The blue-workbench edit also reports successful process completion only. [X0943, `test/commons_16007442/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0942, `test/commons_16007442/record.json`, lines 16–34; X0952, `test/commons_16007442/text_edit/status.json`, lines 2–5]

### Dormitory and separate selection item

The dormitory’s top-level code models grouped iron bunks and bedding, wardrobe and fireplace; it conditionally adds procedural noise bump to materials, and specifies a 31.5 mm camera, two area lights and 512×341 Cycles render. Step 2 is recorded as selected and the record reports functional passes for `fireplace`, but no step-2 execution result is supplied here. [X0953, `test/commons_163096530/build.py`, lines 51–101, 103–169, 224–275; X0955, `test/commons_163096530/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0954, `test/commons_163096530/record.json`, lines 16–34]

A different selection scene, `commons_138420790`, logged a successful step-3 16-sample render; its code and selection decision are not in this source set. [X0927, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]

**Conclusion:** Successful rendering and operability checks are not independent visual-quality acceptance. The reported similarity scores, absent images, and null contact/completeness fields leave reconstruction quality and physical connections unresolved; timeouts and exceptions are technical failures, distinct from completed renders that may still reconstruct poorly.
